title: Language Foundations
subtitle: The JavaScript behavior that shows up in real code reviews
description: Build a reliable mental model for values, variables, equality, coercion, copying, and modern syntax. The goal is not trivia; it is avoiding bugs in everyday code.
learningOutcomes: Choose const, let, and var correctly
Predict equality and coercion outcomes without relying on memorized trivia
Use destructuring, spread, optional chaining, and nullish coalescing safely
Explain why primitives and object references behave differently
